name: Gokigen Na Schmetterlinge
source:
The coaches of a children's tennis school are preparing to go to summer camp with their students.

[From [url=https://atpprojects.itch.io/gokigennaschmetterlinge]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一所少儿网球学校的教练们，正准备和学生们一起去参加夏令营。
